meta.title: Juane Elizondo — Front End Developer
meta.description: Front end developer based in Mendoza, Argentina. Co-founder of Hornero Digital, building my own products: Evalene and Sendo.

hero.headlineAfter: A front end focused developer based in Mendoza. I co-founded Hornero Digital and build my own products.

evalene.title: Evalene
evalene.listDescription: Practice management with appointments and WhatsApp/email reminders.
evalene.lead: Less admin work for your practice: appointments, patients and clinical notes in one calm place, with WhatsApp and email reminders.

facts.role: Product, front end, backend and infrastructure

about: Evalene exists to simplify the day-to-day of a medical practice. The schedule, each patient's record and clinical notes live together in a calm interface, built to be used between sessions.
I designed and built the whole product, from idea to production.

sendo.title: Sendo
sendo.listDescription: Stock and sales management for small businesses. Contract project.
sendo.lead: Stock and sales management system for small businesses: products, movements and sales, without the overhead of a full ERP.
about: Many shops still track stock on a spreadsheet. Sendo shows in one view what's in stock, what's about to run out, and what sold.
I work on the product on contract. The focus is making the most frequent task, logging a movement, take seconds.

hornero.title: Hornero Digital
hornero.listDescription: Website and brand identity for the Odoo consultancy I co-founded.
hornero.lead: The Odoo implementation consultancy I co-founded. I built the website and the brand identity.
about: The hornero bird builds its home out of mud, one careful layer at a time, made to last. The brand takes that idea: tidy implementations that stay with a company for the long run.
I designed the identity and built the consultancy's website.

about.heading: About me

statement.text: I like an interface to feel
, even when there's complex logic behind it. I design and build products end to end, from the idea to the point where someone uses them

about.prose: I work with React, Tailwind and TypeScript on the front end, and with Java, Spring Boot and Supabase on the server side. Before that, I worked as a contractor on projects in tourism, insurance, fitness, rentals and sales.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.question: Have a project in mind? Write to me and let's talk about it.
